objective: Find Hammertoe's Amulet and return it to him in Uldaman.

description: Ye're brave... <cough>... to come into Uldaman fer me, <class>.
If ye're really here to help... ol' Hammertoe, then... <cough>... you'll need to find... me amulet.

Deepshadow's got it... Magregan Deepshadow. He's 'round here... in the ruins fer sure. That amulet'll lead 'em... <cough>...  right to the scrolls if he ain't stopped. It's up to you, <name>. Please... get that amulet.
The scrolls will surely help the Dark Irons create even more powerful golems. I just know it. I can feel it in me bones.
progress: The Shadowforge clan... <cough> is dangerous. Be careful. <cough> You must find the amulet.
completion: Ah knew you'd find me amulet, <name>.
